svg.title: Pseudo-sprite: a drawing made of dots and X
svg.desc: On the left, the code of a pseudo-sprite called folder: ten lines of dots and X between << and >>. In the middle, the same grid enlarged, each X a black pixel, forming a folder. On the right, a sample screen with four folders, Documents, Pictures, Music and Videos, all using the same sprite.
svg.text: Pseudo-sprite: a drawing made of dots and X
Each character becomes a pixel; then the drawing is reused by name
one definition, as many uses as you like
Only X is drawn (any other character is left blank), and the sprite must be alone in its cell.
